text.name: Oslo Accords
text.rules: Record "handshake". LIO spends 1 point on actions. SAE chooses: Back the spoilers? If yes, SAE spends 1 point on actions, then at the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point placing influence; if no, LIO spends 1 point on actions. Lower Escalation by 1.
text.history: Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization signed the Oslo Declaration of Principles at the White House on 13 September 1993, setting out a framework for Palestinian self-government.
